sourceProvenance.title: Bella Ciao
sourceProvenance.edition: Manuela Goessnitzer, O Bella ciao, CC0 LilyPond edition, 2015/2019; source melody independently represented in D minor with simplified original Pianify left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Traditional folk melody; Pianify notation derived from a CC0 LilyPond edition; no television-series arrangement or branding
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

sourceReference.redistribution: not bundled; LilyPond source remains the external reference

crossCheckReferences.role: source page publishes the complete melody and accompaniment notation under CC0

derivation.melody: independent deterministic notation of the CC0 LilyPond melody; the title, metadata, cover and arrangement contain no La Casa de Papel reference
derivation.harmony: Pianify editorial piano harmonization v1, clearly separated from the source melody
